#!/bin/bash

service_name=UnmI2Web
current_path=$(cd `dirname $0`; pwd)
parent_path=$(cd `dirname $0`; cd ..; pwd)

echo current_path=$current_path
echo parent_path=$parent_path
chmod -R 777 $current_path

current_service=$current_path/UnmI2Web-back.service
dest_current_service=$current_path/UnmI2Web.service

if [ -e $dest_current_service ];
then
  rm -f $dest_current_service
fi
cp $current_service $dest_current_service

sed -i -e 's|\${home_path}|'"$current_path"'|g' $dest_current_service


# cp start_unm_web.server /etc/init.d/
cp $current_path/UnmI2Web.service /usr/lib/systemd/system
systemctl disable $service_name

#sh startI2Check.sh

#systemctl start $service_name

current_health_service=$current_path/I2WebCheck/UnmI2WebHealthCheck-back.service
dest_current_health_service=$current_path/I2WebCheck/UnmI2WebHealthCheck.service

if [ -e $dest_current_health_service ];
then
  rm -f $dest_current_health_service
fi
cp $current_health_service $dest_current_health_service

sed -i -e 's|\${home_path}|'"$current_path"'|g' $dest_current_health_service


cp $current_path/I2WebCheck/UnmI2WebHealthCheck.service /usr/lib/systemd/system

systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable UnmI2WebHealthCheck.service
systemctl start UnmI2WebHealthCheck.service

record.rsp_body:
@echo off

cd /d %~dp0
cd ..
set WEB_HOME=%cd%

set MYSQL_HOME=%WEB_HOME%/thirdparty/mysql
cd %MYSQL_HOME%/bin

if not exist my.ini (
    echo create msql initialize file...
    (
    echo [mysql]
    echo default-character-set=utf8mb4
    echo [mysqld]
    echo port = 3306
    echo basedir= %MYSQL_HOME%/
    echo datadir= %MYSQL_HOME%/data
    echo max_connections=50
    echo character-set-server=utf8
    echo default-storage-engine=INNODB
    echo default_authentication_plugin=mysql_native_password
    ) > my.ini
    echo install mysql...
    cd %MYSQL_HOME%/
    mkdir data
    cd %MYSQL_HOME%/bin
    mysqld --initialize-insecure --user=root
    mysqld --install

    echo start mysql server...
    net start mysql

    echo set pwd for root...
    set username=root
    set pwd=vislecaina
    mysql -uroot -e "alter user '%username%'@'localhost' identified by '%pwd%';"

    echo load database data...
    mysql -uroot -p%pwd% < %WEB_HOME%/service/cable-health-monitor/db/cablehealthdb.sql"

    mysql -uroot -p%pwd% < %WEB_HOME%/service/cable-health-monitor/db/t_operationinfo_sql.sql"

    mysql -uroot -p%pwd% < %WEB_HOME%/service/cable-health-monitor/db/t_role_operation_sql.sql"

) else (
    echo start mysql server...
    net start mysql
)

cd %WEB_HOME% in
pause

#!/bin/bash
#检测nginx是否启动了
A=`ps -C nginx --no-header |wc -l`        
echo A
if [ $A -eq 0 ];then    #如果nginx没有启动就启动nginx                        
      systemctl start nginx                #重启nginx
      if [ `ps -C nginx --no-header |wc -l` -eq 0 ];then    #nginx重启失败，则停掉keepalived服务，进行VIP转移
              killall keepalived                    
      fi
fi
echo bbbbb

#!/bin/bash

currentdir=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")"; pwd)

localip=`ip a|grep inet|grep -v 127.0.0.1|grep -v inet6|awk '{print $2}'|awk -F'/' '{print $1}'`
echo "服务器IP："$localip
port=`grep port config.json |grep "|awk -F':' '{print $2}'|grep "|awk -F'"' '{print $2}'`
echo "端口："$port

source /etc/profile
nohup node $currentdir/vendors/server/app.js >/dev/null 2>&1 &

yapinum=`ps -ef|grep vendors/server/app.js|grep -v grep|awk '{print $2}'|wc -l`
while [[ 1 != $yapinum ]]; do
	yapinum=`ps -ef|grep vendors/server/app.js|grep -v grep|awk '{print $2}'|wc -l`
	echo "等待yapi服务启动"
	sleep 5
done

java -jar ../sliceTool/SliceTool.jar ice2yapi $localip:$port
